author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 해마다 수십 마리가 찾아오는 드문 겨울철새로, 12월부터 3월 사이 강원 고성과 경북 포항 구룡포 등 동해 앞바다에서 관찰된다. 북극해와 북태평양·북대서양의 바닷가 절벽에 무리 지어 번식하며, 좁은 바위 턱에 알을 1개 낳는다. 잠수해 대구·열빙어·까나리 같은 물고기와 새우 같은 갑각류를 잡아먹는다.

art.subject: Thick-billed Murre (Uria lomvia), adult in winter plumage, as seen off the Korean east coast from December to March: crown, hindneck and upperparts blackish, the dark cap extending down over the face to well below the eye; chin, throat and foreneck white; breast and belly white; narrow white tips to the secondaries form a thin white line on the closed wing. Bill black, stout and fairly short, with a thin whitish line along the base of the upper mandible's cutting edge; dark eye.
art.pose: swimming low on the sea, about to dive
art.scene: Korean East Sea off the northeast coast in winter, grey choppy water and a dark rocky headland in the distance; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in winter, side view swimming low on the sea: blackish crown, hindneck and upperparts, more black on the face than a Common Murre, white lower face, throat and foreneck, white underparts, thick, fairly short black bill with a white stripe along the upper mandible at the gape
adult in winter, side view standing upright on a rock: heavy body, blackish upperparts and head, white lower face, throat, breast and belly, thick black bill with the white gape stripe
art.build: Large, heavy-bodied auk, clearly smaller than a Mallard, a little larger and stockier than a Common Murre, with a thick neck. Bill straight, black, shorter and deeper than a Common Murre's, with a gently curved ridge. Swims low on the water with the tail barely visible; stands upright on rocks. Wings short and narrow; flight fast and direct with whirring wingbeats.
avoid: Do not paint white cheeks with a thin dark line behind the eye; that is Common Murre (Uria aalge) in winter.
Do not paint a long, slender, sharply pointed bill (Common Murre).
Do not omit the thin whitish line along the base of the upper mandible.
Do not paint brown tones on the upperparts; they are blackish.
Do not paint a colourful bill or orange feet (puffins).
